summary: Rivian Automotive, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 75,000,000 shares of Class A common stock, with a 30-day option for underwriters to purchase up to an additional 11,250,000 shares. The offering is at-the-market with a reference price of $18.63 per share as of July 2, 2026. Joint book-running managers include Goldman Sachs, Allen Company, Barclays, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley, and Wells Fargo Securities. This is a routine capital raise via a shelf takedown, not a special situation. Proceeds are intended for general corporate purposes. No event-driven special situation occurs.
